regions.merged_text: God bless you Mrs. Stone - you and yours. Why worry so easily! Is not God watching over us the divine Aut'or of all beautiful solicitude? Rather start now to thank Him for His designs for your future. "God condecends to use our powers If we don't spoil His plans by ours".
